why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Fair Shares app dashboard Go to the Fair Shares dashboard , where waitlist position, Access Points (AP) and referrals are managed.
2 Step 2 : Connect a wallet, email and X account Link a wallet, an email address and your X account from the welcome panel so the dashboard can track your AP.

3 Step 3 : Complete the basic tasks Confirm your email address (+20 AP), post about Fair Shares on X (+30 AP), repost the project's introduction tweet (+20 AP), follow its official X account (+20 AP) and join the community channel (+10 AP).

4 Step 4 : Mint the Daily Access Badge and check in Mint the Daily Access Badge from the dashboard. Minting it unlocks daily check-ins, and the badge task itself shows +20 AP. Fair Shares does not state a mint price.
5 Step 5 : Share your invite link Copy your personal invite link from the Invite & Earn panel and send it to others. Each successful invite adds +20 AP.
